name: Laundry Lab
tagline: Decode labels, kill stains, keep clothes new
about: Laundry Lab reads care labels from a photo, tells you exactly how to treat any stain, sorts a week's washing into the fewest safe loads and rescues shrunken, faded or bobbled clothes.
persona: You are a textile-care expert who has run a dry-cleaner's front desk: precise about fibres, temperatures and chemistry, honest about what is unsalvageable.

onboarding.title: Wash it right the first time
onboarding.subtitle: Tell us about your machine and how you dry.
bullets: Care labels decoded from a photo

tools.title: Read a care label
tools.subtitle: Photo → plain-English instructions
tools.prompt: Decode the care label symbols in the photo for this item: {item}. Sections: a table (Symbol | Meaning | What to actually do on the profile's machine); kv (wash temp, spin, detergent type, dry method, iron setting, dry-clean?); bullets on what happens if you ignore each rule; and a callout on the safest setting if in doubt.

tools.title: Remove a stain
tools.subtitle: What it is, what it's on, how old
tools.prompt: Remove {stain} from {fabric}; the stain is {age}. Sections: steps in exact order with product, temperature and timing, starting with what NOT to do; kv (chance of full removal, active ingredient that works, household substitute); a table (Product | Works because | Risk to this fabric); and a callout on when to stop and take it to a professional.

tools.title: Sort my washing
tools.subtitle: Fewest loads, nothing ruined

inputs.label: What's in the pile
inputs.placeholder: 5 white tees, 2 pairs jeans, gym kit, a red hoodie, bath towels, silk blouse…

tools.prompt: Sort this washing pile: {pile}, optimising for {goal}, on the profile's machine and drying setup. Sections: a table (Load | Items | Temp | Cycle | Spin | Detergent | Dry) with the load count; steps for the order to run them so drying space works; bullets of items that must not share a load; and a callout on anything to hand-wash or skip.

tools.title: Rescue a garment
tools.subtitle: Shrunk, faded, bobbled, stiff, smelly
tools.prompt: Rescue this: {item}, which is {problem}. Sections: text with an honest prognosis; steps for the fix with exact water temperatures, products, ratios and timings; bullets on preventing it next time on the profile's setup; and a callout on when the fix could make it worse.

tools.title: Machine care & cycles
tools.subtitle: Clean the washer, pick cycles, stop the smell
tools.prompt: Address '{issue}' for the profile's machine, drying setup and water hardness. Sections: text explaining the cause; steps for the fix with products and frequencies; a table (Cycle | Use for | Temp | Time | Notes) of the 6 cycles worth using; and a checklist of monthly machine maintenance.

disclaimer: Follow product labels; never mix bleach with ammonia or acids, and ventilate when using solvents. Test any treatment on a hidden area first. General guidance, not professional textile-care advice.
